problem.title: SuMa shared initial coarse registration on KITTI 06 full
problem.question: Does a fixed initial coarse-to-fine stage derived from the existing IMLS-SLAM choice transfer to SuMa without tuning?

variants.label: SuMa raw paper path + initial coarse registration (1 frame, 5x distance, 10 iterations)
variants.intent: Non-paper opt-in, default off. One initial registration and ten coarse iterations derive from existing IMLS04 calibration; 5x distance multiplier derives from its r=1.0/0.2. Different per-method residuals and stopping rules remain local. No SuMa sweep; historical full KITTI results already known. Experimental evidence only; no published leaderboard/Table6/paper ratio promotion.
variants.note: SuMa paper pipeline (SuMaPaper: rendered surfel model, projective frame-to-model ICP, surfel stability and fusion per RSS 2018 / official default.xml); raw scans, no GT seed, no loop closure. frame-to-frame fallbacks=0; opt-in initial coarse registrations=1 frames=1 distance_scale=5.000000 max_iterations=10 (not in the paper)
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
